name: Merom
overview: Merom is identified in Scripture as the location near the springs of the Jordan River where a confederation of kings, led by Jabin, king of Hazor, assembled to confront Israel. In Joshua 11, these kings pitched their forces by the waters of Merom to battle against God's people. The LORD assured Joshua of victory, promising to deliver their enemies into Israel's hands, which was fulfilled when Joshua and the Israelite army launched a sudden attack, defeating them decisively. This event highlights God's sovereign protection and power in granting Israel triumph over formidable foes.
